bookkeeping_audit.source_adapter_scope: Only absent Git metadata and checkout-exclusion plumbing are adapted for archived source; model, data, selection, scoring and budget logic are unchanged.

classification: Limited representation component pilot; reject these nonlinear acquisition configurations, not the broad representation hypothesis.
confirmation_reason: The nonlinear observation challenge failed tiny-set acquisition in all 12 admitted fits; no claim-specific representation-transfer prerequisite was met.

costs.artifact_measurement: artifact_bytes is the conservative allocated-on-disk charge used by storage admission; logical_artifact_bytes sums ordinary file lengths.
costs.sampled_rss_gap: The injected failed worker has no returned supervisor sample summary; its wall time and worker high-water RSS are retained.
costs.scope: All pilot attempts including preflight, injected failure, unsuccessful fits, verification and restored-source replays. Dense forward arithmetic excludes backward/optimizer FLOPs; those have separate operation counts. Archive I/O and offline JSON analysis are separate. Prior diagnostic and earlier campaigns retain their own complete cost records.

aligned.scope: Initial observations and reconstruction targets are audited. Training sees no held-out state; later prefixes may revisit training states. Net computations exclude all permitted training subwords. Final word structures are counted, but final trajectories are never rendered.

nonlinear.scope: Initial observations and reconstruction targets are audited. Training sees no held-out state; later prefixes may revisit training states. Net computations exclude all permitted training subwords. Final word structures are counted, but final trajectories are never rendered.

matched_aligned_consistency_effect.scope: Three initialization seeds, one finite world, shared cases; not independent query-level confidence intervals or a cross-domain claim.

not_admitted.reason: No common aligned condition acquired across all direct seeds.
